word: Title: Morning At Home
I give the plants a little water.
answer: "Doy un poco de agua a las plantas."

word: You let the sunlight in through the window. [sing, inf]
answer: "Dejas entrar la luz por la ventana."

word: We drink a warm cup of coffee.
They finish their breakfast quickly.
I am going to pay the bills later.
answer: "Voy a pagar las cuentas más tarde."

word: You spend a few pesos on bread. [pl]
We take out the trash before leaving.
They remove the old papers from the table.
answer: "Quitan los papeles viejos de la mesa."

word: You drive carefully through the neighborhood. [sing, formal]
I open the windows for fresh air.
answer: "Abro las ventanas para que entre aire."

word: We are going to love the quiet morning.
They wash the dishes together.
You cook eggs with vegetables. [sing, inf]
We clean the kitchen after eating.
They dry the cups with a small towel.
You are going to bathe the dog later. [pl]
answer: "Van a bañar al perro más tarde."

word: I matter to my family a lot.
We interest the kids with a fun idea.
answer: "Interesamos a los niños con una idea divertida."

word: They bother each other playfully.
You win a small prize from a cereal box. [sing, formal]
answer: "Gana un pequeño premio de una caja de cereal."

word: I go up the stairs to get my bag.
answer: "Subo las escaleras para agarrar mi bolsa."

word: We come down to the living room.
They dance to a quick song.
You are going to tie the bags before leaving. [sing, inf]
answer: "Vas a atar las bolsas antes de salir."

word: We tell a short story before heading out.
answer: "Contamos una historia corta antes de salir."
